kind: fresh narrow source-guard fix after acquisition stop
usable_improvement: Default figure builder refuses missing required face assets before attaching any part, with the complete exact missing-source list; explicit --no-face-parts diagnostic retains its opt-out.
bounded_research_question: Can source resolution be made complete before part attachment while preserving exact successful tuple order, high/low eye override, argument opt-out and original exceptions, using actual-function injected resolver/attachment tests without Blender?
decision: Ship only the narrow source-level guard if missing-owner cases abort before all attachments and successful/diagnostic behavior stays the same; otherwise collect failure and hold without native retry.
frozen_source_witness: Store the exact original attach_face_parts function/table dependency regions before edit; full original builder remains recoverable at entry commit3b35264 and is not copied wholesale.
allowed_after_worth: Read only exact source table constants needed by attach_face_parts; change only this function to two phases: resolve all expected sources, abort on any missing, then attach in original order. Add one meaningful actual-function AST-extracted injected-resolver test with complete all-present/high-low-eye/opt-out and each declared missing owner, grouped missing owners, lookup exception and attachment exception cases. No bpy/module import or native launch.
forbidden: No native authoring/acquisition or rig/parser/reader/geometry trial, target application, GLB/BIN/gzip/arrays or asset hash; no body/macro/rig/export/material/groom/wardrobe change, accepted asset/output edit, API call change, dependency/install/model/subscription/purchase/reset/push/publication or other project work. No source authority/form/runtime claim from stub tests.
stop_condition: Worth refusal, scope beyond attach_face_parts, changed successful ordering/path/argument behavior, partial attachment on missing input, failed meaningful tests, review refusal or cutoff. No trial or broader rescue in this slice.

alternatives.description: Resolve complete required face sources first and abort before attachments (selected nomination).
alternatives.tradeoff: A broken installation fails early instead of yielding partial native face output; retains explicit diagnostics and unchanged successful source path.

alternatives.description: Add a separate complete-source manifest/provenance authoring preflight without changing the builder.
alternatives.tradeoff: Broader ownership authority is still needed for Ari, but it would not prevent this default partial attachment path and costs more; do not substitute another metadata list for the guard.

qualification: Source-level completeness guard only. It does not acquire Ari source, qualify installed API behavior or make a new body/anatomy/rig/fit/render/runtime result. Existing Ari recipe hold and wider roadmap remain open.
